intended_behavior: Modify the _is_session_active method to additionally check if the _close_future is done. The method should return False if either the background thread is None or not alive, or if the _close_future exists and is done. This change ensures that during the window after an uncaught exception closes the session and sets _close_future but before the background thread fully exits, _is_session_active will accurately reflect the session is no longer active, preventing new tasks from being scheduled and avoiding indefinite hanging of the agent. Existing functionality regarding thread aliveness should be preserved.
